ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New business, Proposal sent and later stages need Amount, Decision date and Competitive pitch.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_business", CASE(StageName, "Lead", 1, "Discovery", 2, "Brief and scope", 3, "Proposal sent (New business)", 4, "Pitch or review", 5, "Negotiation (New business)", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(Decision_date__c), NOT(Competitive_pitch__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Decision date and Competitive pitch before moving to Proposal sent.
